verdict.rationale: Khoj lets users control data location by self-hosting on their own hardware via Docker or Pip, and pairing it with local models such as Ollama so data never leaves the device. There is no evidence of region or residency selection for Khoj Cloud, so residency choice comes only from self-hosting. Missing for 10: region/residency selection in Khoj Cloud, documented data-location guarantees for the hosted service, independent hands-on verification of fully local data storage.
